author: _ImDone
body:
First of all, let me get something straight. I am Hacktivism's alternate account. I was banned on May 17th, 2015, by Pizza334, for having an inappropriate username.

I'm assuming the word "fagot" in my name was the reason I was banned. However, this word is not necessarily inappropriate. In the English language, it holds the meaning of "a bundle of sticks or twigs bound together as fuel". It can also mean "iron rods bound together for heating, reheating, wielding, and hammering into bars". In the Spanish language, it means "bassoon", which is a type of woodwind instrument. Therefore, that would mean "Principal Fagot" is actually an orchestral position; it's the name of the lead bassoon player. Unless you were looking up the definition in the Urban Dictionary, which I wouldn't suggest, the word "fagot" is not inappropriate.

Perhaps you misread and saw the word "faggot" in my name. If that word was actually in my name, then the punishment would be justified. However, since my name refers to an orchestral position, I'm asking to be appealed.

Thank you for your time.
